dialog.description: One record either way — it lands on the calendar for the date you give it, and in the Vault's reminders list while the switch beside the title is on.

title.label: Title
title.error: Give it a title you will recognise.

remind.label: Show in reminders
remind.on: Listed in the Vault with a tick box, and on the calendar for its date.
remind.off: On the calendar for its date only — no tick box in the Vault.

kind.label: Kind
kind.hintFollowUp: A follow-up also appears in Follow-ups due on the dashboard, until you tick it off.
kind.hint: The icon it carries on the calendar and in the reminders list.

detail.label: Detail
detail.hint: One line of context, shown under the title.

note.label: Note
note.hint: Your own scribble. Kept apart from the detail, so an edit never clobbers it.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.hint: Shared with applications, files and links — filtering by one finds all of them.

schedule.dateError: Pick a date — an undated item has nowhere to appear.

allDay.label: All day
allDay.description: Off gives it a start time and a length, and puts it on the calendar's hour grid.

application.label: Related application
application.hint: Links them, so each application lists this and this leads back to any of them.

toast.inRemindersAndFollowUps: {{when}} — in reminders as a reminder — and in Follow-ups due
toast.stillThereUnnamed: The reminder is still on the calendar.
toast.goneBoth: Gone from the reminders list and from the calendar.
